import re
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_note_token, note_id=3085)
content = note['content']
pattern = r"- (\w+) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for \"([^\"]+)\". Owed equally by (.+)\."
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        m = re.match(pattern, line)
        if m:
            payer, amount, desc, debtors_str = m.groups()
            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors_str.split(',')]
            print(f"Payer: {payer}, Amount: {amount}, Desc: {desc}, Debtors: {debtors}")
        else:
            print(f"No match: {line}")
